title: hieracium pilosella subsp. pachyanthoides
intro: Hieracium pilosella subsp. pachyanthoides, commonly known as Meadow Hawkweed, is a type of flowering plant in the dandelion family (Asteraceae). It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which may help to soothe wounds and reduce the risk of infection. The therapeutic actions of Meadow Hawkweed are attributed to its ability to stimulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, sesquiterpenes, and phenolic acids, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
